author: omar
body: Im expecting a ios settings like button where one can configure which mushaf, toggle for enable / disable takeed, language, etc

author: claude
body: Planned as one settings button that opens a list like the phone's own Settings, with mus'haf, tajweed colours and language as its first three rows: item ④ in `docs/design/app-layout.md`. Today's panel holds 47 groups of settings, so the plan also asks you where the rarely used ones should go (item ⑦). Not built yet.
